text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Asthma exacerbation. The gradual onset of dyspnea with exertion, presence of expiratory wheezing, and lack of hemoptysis or chest tightness, combined with the inability to order confirmatory tests, strongly points to an asthma flare-up.
